thread:
support_jess: FYI customer reporting widespread 502s + timeouts hitting hosted inference in eu-west-2 since ~10:22 UTC. They sent curl repro and SDK errors. Escalating — customer on support P1.

oncall_ryan: Acknowledge. I'm on it, pinging infra and net. Can someone drop the aggregate 5xx graph? @sre-bot any alerts?

sre-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate spike for service=hosted-inference region=eu-west-2 window=10:23-10:35 UTC (5xx rate +18% p50 latency +120ms).

alex_net: Seeing per-AZ egress packet loss spikes on az eu-west-2b -> transit provider A around the same window. Microbursts on interface eth2: "drops 0.9% avg 10s".

marta_infra: Confirmed. BGP path churn to provider A, ECMP rehashing causing retransmits. Control plane (auth/billing) looks fine — errors coming from model-serving frontends to external egress.

support_jess: Customer supplied curl:```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
error body: "gateway timeout: upstream/reset"
They also reported SDK timeouts (node sdk) from eu-west-2 only.

oncall_ryan: Are any customer requests being retried and amplifying load? We should rate-limit retries at the edge if possible.

alex_net: We see request retries from some large tenants but not enough to explain initial spike. Root cause looks like transient packetloss on provider A causing TCP retransmits and some TLS handshakes to drop. Traceroute from frontends:```traceroute to providerA.edge (10.4.1.1): 1 10.0.0.1 2 100.64.23.9 3 * * * 4 192.0.2.45 (ASXXXX) 5 198.51.100.1```lots of * at hop 3-4 intermittently.

luis_prod: Mitigation options? Can we fail traffic off provider A to provider B for eu-west-2 egress? Also consider diverting affected customer prefixes to eu-west-1 as emergency fallback.

marta_infra: Working on BGP community-based prepend to reduce traffic via provider A; applying temporary route-policy to bias to provider B. Rolling now (few mins). Also enabling aggressive ECMP deconvergence to avoid rehash storms.

oncall_ryan: Support: please notify affected customers proactively with ETA ~30-45m. Add fallback note: try retry with exponential backoff.

support_jess: Notifying customers now. Patch message: "We're investigating degraded API performance in eu-west-2 causing 502s/timeouts. We're applying routing mitigations and will provide updates." :warning:

alex_net: Early telemetry shows 5xx rate starting to decline after route changes (10:34 UTC). Packet loss reduced from ~1% to ~0.08% on eth2. Still seeing occasional TLS resets.

marta_infra: Provider A acknowledged intermittent microbursts on peering link; they've opened a ticket and queued a TAC review. We'll keep failover in place while they analyze optics.

luis_prod: Can we enable per-tenant regional fallback in the console as a short-term setting? If not, let's at least add a routing policy to shift critical customers.

alex_net: For immediate repro: run quick curl with --resolve to force eu-west-2 frontend, then run tcpdump on frontend container to reproduce 502s. Example:```curl --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:10.3.4.12 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -d '{"input":"x"}'``` capture shows TCP retransmits and occasional TLS recv errors.

oncall_ryan: Good. I've started a postmortem doc and assigned owner Alex. Tutoring note: confirm if our connection pooling is misbehaving when upstream resets occur; we should avoid saturating sockets.

support_jess: Customer acknowledged the update and will validate client-side after 10:45 UTC. They reported reduced error rate but not fully resolved.

marta_infra: Follow-ups: keep failover active until provider TAC confirms fix; collect pcap and optical logs; prepare to engage second carrier if SLA penalties apply.

alex_net: Summary: cause = intermittent provider egress microbursts + ECMP churn -> retransmits -> upstream gateway 502s for inference frontends in eu-west-2. Mitigation = route bias to provider B, apply ECMP deconverge, support notified, postmortem in progress.

oncall_ryan: Closing loop: I'll update incident channel with timeline and owner once postmortem skeleton ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
